description: Evolution of Ton-km on Infrabel network is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Brutotonnage uitgedrukt in ton-km vervoerd op het spoorwegnet van Infrabel, per kwartaal en per sector. Een ton-km is een meeteenheid van goederenvervoer die overeenkomt met het vervoer van één ton (1000 kg) goederen per spoor over een afstand van één kilometer. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are ton-km, Spoorverkeer, Goederenvervoer, Reizigers. The portal shows 294 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
